title: 2011 Prairie, the Romanesque house beside Mayer, gets its turret
items: 2011 Prairie, next door to the Meyer house, now stands as two old pictures show it: a narrow front of rough rock-faced stone, a round-arched door at its north end with a cross window over it, a gabled dormer in the slate roof, and a round corner turret rising past the roofline to a slate cone. The turret's roof is still one plain cone where the photograph shows a flared skirt under it; that comes next.
